name: Scarlet Armband
summary: In Deathknell, Scarlet Armbands mark the zealots pressing into Forsaken territory. Executor Arren demands them as proof that the newly risen have struck back.

sections.title: A Badge of Fanaticism
sections.body: Scarlet Armbands mark the Scarlet Crusade's followers, from Initiates to fresh converts. The Crusade's red insignia warns newly risen Forsaken in Deathknell that danger waits close by. Crusaders make no distinction between the Scourge's mindless servants and the free-willed subjects of the Dark Lady. To them, every walking corpse must burn. Executor Arren gathers the armbands to confirm that enemy scouts southeast of Deathknell have died and that new Forsaken can defend their fledgling nation.

faq.q: Why does Executor Arren want Scarlet Armbands?
faq.answer: Executor Arren wants Scarlet Armbands as proof that the Scarlet Crusade encampment southeast of Deathknell is being culled. The Crusade threatens newly awakened Forsaken, and the tokens show its forward scouts and recruits have been eliminated.
Scarlet Initiates, Scarlet Converts, and the messenger Meven Korgal wear these armbands. They are lower-ranking members of the Scarlet Crusade stationed near Deathknell.

faq.q: Why does the Scarlet Crusade hate the Forsaken?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade hates the Forsaken because its zealots see no difference between the Lich King's mindless Scourge and the free-willed Forsaken. They regard all undead as abominations to be eradicated.

faq.q: Where is the camp where these armbands can be found?
faq.answer: The camp lies just southeast of Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades, in the hills beyond the settlement's perimeter.

angles.text: As a newly raised Forsaken, gathering Scarlet Armbands brings you face to face with the living world's hatred. Your survival depends on defending yourself against the Crusade.
